messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected for /stream in eu-west-1
- p95 = 320ms (SLO 200ms), p99 = 1200ms (SLO 800ms)
- streaming stall rate +6x over last 5m
- prefixcache hitrate dropped: 87% -> 42%
- correlated with prefix-hash rollout at 02:12 UTC (canary)
- paging oncall: maya (P1)

maya (oncall): I'm on it. scaling this to P1 + paging eng-sre.
Collecting quick artifacts: can someone post the rollout PR/sha?

sam: PR #4120 merged at 02:12 UTC by luis. sha: ab3f9d2. That rollout changed the prefix hash mapping logic and TTL behaviour.

maya (oncall): thanks. immediate mitigations I plan to try:
- scale prefetch workers in eu-west-1 +2 replicas
- temporarily increase prefixcache TTL from 30s -> 120s for eu-west-1
- enable fallback path (non-prefetch) for heavy streaming sessions (10% traffic)
- consider rolling back the prefix-hash canary if miss rate doesn't improve in 5m

maya (oncall): running scaling command now:
```
kubectl scale deploy/prefetch-worker -n inference --replicas=6 --context=eu-west-1
```

ops-bot: scaling deploy/prefetch-worker -> 6 replicas (eu-west-1) — done (2024-06-11T02:18:12Z)

luis: i can kick the TTL bump via configflag. pushing now (feature-flag: prefixcache.ttl_override).

ops-bot: feature-flag prefixcache.ttl_override = 120s applied to eu-west-1 (2024-06-11T02:19:03Z)

ryan: FYI support is receiving customer tickets re: streaming stalls and partial transcripts for live captioning. one enterprise customer (acme-media) reported 2 minute stall on live feed at ~02:20 UTC.

jen: adding runbook link for quick reference: https://internal/runbooks/streaming-latency-triage

maya (oncall): grabbing metrics snapshot for posterity:
```
metrics: region=eu-west-1 window=5m
prefixcache.hit_rate: 0.42 (was 0.87 at 01:50)
streaming.stall_rate: 6.1x baseline
latency.p95: 320ms
latency.p99: 1200ms
active.streams: +18% over baseline
```

maya (oncall): initial hypothesis: prefix-hash change caused key churn -> mass invalidations -> prefetch thrash -> backend pressure -> streaming stalls/tail latency.

alex: I'm taking over next. maya — summarize current state for handoff and any actions you want persisted.

maya (oncall): Handoff to alex at 2263001560. Open mitigations:
- prefetch-worker scaled to 6 (ops-bot confirmed)
- prefixcache TTL overridden to 120s in eu-west-1
- fallback path enabled for 10% streaming traffic (traffic-shift rule active)
- support notified, acme-media on incident watch
- current numbers: p99 down from 1600 -> 1200ms, stall_rate from 8x -> 5.5x

Tasks for alex:
1) validate rollback plan (safe rollback for prefix-hash canary)
2) monitor p95/p99 and stream stall metrics for both eu-west-1 and failover region
3) coordinate with support on impacted customers and update comms
4) run a controlled traffic shift if needed to us-east-1 (20% -> 30%)

alex: taking it. I'm going to attempt a controlled rollback of the canary in eu-west-1 to see if hitrate recovers. Will prepare rollback notes and ETA ~ 8-10m.

alex: rollback command I will run:
```
# rollback canary prefix-hash rollout in eu-west-1
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/prefix-hash-canary --to-revision=3 --context=eu-west-1
```

deploy-bot: Received rollback job for deploy/prefix-hash-canary (eu-west-1). starting.

ops-bot: rollout undo completed for prefix-hash-canary -> revision 3 (2024-06-11T02:27:41Z)

alex: rollback finished. waiting 2m for caches to settle, then will re-evaluate hitrate.

sam: watching metrics. initial read after rollback (1m): prefixcache.hit_rate -> 58% (up from 42%). streaming.stall_rate down to 3.2x. p99 trending downward to ~900ms.

alex: good signal. continuing observation. moving traffic shift up to 25% to us-east-1 to give extra headroom.

ops-bot: traffic policy updated: /stream eu-west-1 -> us-east-1 25% (safe-shift) (2024-06-11T02:33:02Z)

support-bot: customers flagged: acme-media (enterprise), demo-partners (3 seats), several small customers (automatic noisy signals). support rep assigned: ryan. Customer comms draft pinned.

ryan: sending first update to acme-media now. cc: customer success.

alex: current status summary for handoff to next oncall (2263001890):
- mitigations applied: scale, TTL bump, rollback completed, partial traffic shift
- metrics improved: p95 ~ 210ms, p99 ~ 720ms, stall_rate ~1.8x (still above baseline)
- customer impact: degraded streaming for some customers, acme-media experienced 2m stall, support engaged
- next steps: investigate root cause for why canary change caused increased churn (key fingerprinting edge case), add stronger preflight checks for prefix-hash rollout (simulated miss-rate test), follow-up postmortem scheduled

alex: handing off to night oncall (luis). please watch p99 and stall_rate for next 30m, keep support updates going, prepare for full rollback if metrics regress.

luis: ack, watching. I'll leave TTL override in place until postmortem decisions.

jen: created follow-up tasks in tracker:
- investigate prefix-hash mapping algorithm regression (owner: eng-ml)
- add simulated traffic test to rollout pipeline (owner: eng-platform)
- improve alerts to tie prefixcache hit-rate deltas to rollout windows (owner: eng-sre)
- customer RTE/incident report (owner: support)

maya (oncall): thanks team. handing back context: if any regression, revert flag and re-route traffic.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: status=mitigated, severity=P1 -> monitoring, incident_lead=alex, start_ts=2263001234, mitigated_ts=2263001703

alex: closing thread for now. will keep watch and open postmortem. great triage everyone. :thumbsup:
